name: Walks toward camera, nothing else
text: She walks forward toward the camera. Nothing else in the frame moves.
desc: The strongest mover with the hold clause attached - approach without the background coming with it.
verdict: RENDERED 2026-08-04, 3 seeds. Motion 2.105/2.476/3.349, mean 2.643 - above the ceiling 3/3, but consistently BELOW plain walk_in on every seed. That is the hold clause doing its job: the same approach with less off-brief motion around it. Use this when the background must stay put and walk_in when it need not.
